scope: Exploratory fixed development validation replay, never blind-test selection
phase_policy: Known task-protocol start pickup_1; hypotheses stay or advance by one witnessed stage, never merge duplicate classes or initialize from class argmax
warning_policy: All four strategies preserve exact frozen B0 Future warning stream; state estimation/recovery affects research Prompt recommendations only, never adds illegal warning transitions
resync_policy: Forward distance at most two; all intermediate stages must have historical Current>=0.5 K2 evidence in the winning path; arrival additionally Current>=0.8 K2; crossing adjust requires witnessed adjust; no backward resets
parameter_origin: Reuse B0 0.5/K2 and Prompt 0.8/K2; beam3 and equal eligible transition priors are fixed engineering limits, not fitted to validation or historical test. No threshold sweep or rule revision after replay.
drift_metrics: Exact sampled phase mismatch includes normal confirmation latency; persistent episodes additionally require >2 seconds continuously (original Current event acceptance window), separately reported
evaluation: Original half-open exact from/to one-to-one 50-event matcher, Future [b-1.5,b); same tail mask and minutes; Prompt strict ordered destination and [b,min(end,b+2))
time_head: Auxiliary metadata only for new policies; frozen historical B2 retained for diagnostic attribution
default: unchanged B0; no deployment config update in this research run
data_constraints: Preserve74/84 checkpoints/results; new10 already training/development, never blind; no test arrays, new encoder training, OpenPI/RTC edits or robot connections
